title: Chapter Review: Topologies and the Physical Layer

questions.prompt: A network with no central server, where every host shares its own resources, is...

How many links does a full mesh of 6 devices need? (a number)
Which topology is low cost but hard to troubleshoot, with one break taking everything down?
Ring networks have good quality because token passing prevents collisions.
Which list is all unguided media?
The loss of signal strength as it travels is called ______. (one word)
A signal loses 10 dB. What fraction of its power is left? (a fraction like 1/4)
Signal leaking between wires placed too close together is...
Which coax carries many signals over long distances using modulation and FDM?
What keeps light inside a fiber's core? (three words)
Fiber-optic cable is prone to EMI and RFI.
Cheap, most common, easy to install, but prone to crosstalk. Which cable?
Which wireless medium needs line of sight, works over just a few meters, and is used in remote controls?
Why is wireless considered inherently less secure?
options: Anyone in range can pick up the signal, without physical access

questions.prompt: Which IEEE standard family is wired Ethernet? (like 802.x)

A badge plus a PIN is multi-factor authentication.
What's the trade-off between on-site and remote backups?
options: On-site is faster to restore; remote survives a disaster at the site
